title: The Ninth Hour
subtitle: None, prayed around 3 p.m., the hour of the death of Christ.
intro: The Ninth Hour remembers the hour at which the Lord gave up His spirit on the Cross. The day's prayers turn toward Vespers from here. About five minutes.
source: Common Orthodox Horologion. Shell shipping today; full Psalm and Troparion text drops in the next content patch.

prayers.title: Opening blessing
prayers.text: Through the prayers of our holy fathers, O Lord Jesus Christ our God, have mercy on us. Amen.

prayers.title: The three Psalms of the Ninth Hour
prayers.instruction: Psalms 83, 84, and 85. Read in full when time allows.
prayers.text: Psalm 83 (How beloved are Thy dwellings) · Psalm 84 (Thou hast been gracious, O Lord, unto Thy land) · Psalm 85 (Bow down Thine ear, O Lord).

prayers.title: Troparion of the death of Christ
prayers.text: O Thou who at the ninth hour for our sake didst taste of death in the flesh: mortify the wisdom of our flesh, O Christ God, and save us.

prayers.title: Dismissal of the Hour
prayers.text: Through the prayers of Thy most pure Mother and of all the saints, have mercy on us and save us. Amen.
